text:
maya: Quick flag — Realtime cost card showed a 4x token cost spike at 16:03 but reconciled numbers later dropped it back. looks like an ingest-order problem again. anyone digging?

liam: saw that. Reconciled view (the backfill) shows normal levels. Realtime = 4x, Reconciled = 1x at 16:05.

sofia: which metric stream is late this time? cache events or token burns?

maya: token-burn events arrived before `prefix_cache_ack` by ~45s. UI pulls materialized view built on arrival-time so spikes appear first.

derek: we're seeing this after the recent producer batching change. we switched partition key -> tenant+model to spread hot tenants. that caused some producers to batch by event_ts which can reorder across partitions.

nora: short-term fix idea: show both views in the Console card: "Realtime (best-effort)" and "Reconciled (final)" with a small reconciliation status indicator. that avoids accidental alerting.

liam: agree. Also mute the 1m anomaly alert for reconciliation window — set spike alert to look at 5m for realtime, and use reconciled for billing alerts.

sofia: UX note: add an inline tooltip explaining "reconciled" timing (e.g., "finalized after event-time processing, usually <=2m"). keep it subtle.

maya: proto SQL we use for reconciled materialization:```sql
-- event_time materialization with 60s allowed lateness
create materialized view econ.reconciled_inv as
select tenant, route, time_bucket('1m', event_time) as t, sum(tokens) as tokens, avg(prefix_cache_hit) as cache_hit, sum(cost) as cost
from invocation_events
group by tenant, route, t
with (watermark = '60s')
```

liam: Flink supports watermarking, but we need to choose allowed lateness. 60s covers most cases but increases "finalization" latency.

nora: tradeoffs: customers care about billing accuracy, teams care about triage speed. propose we expose both in Console and default the dashboard to Realtime for diagnostics, Reconciled for billing exports.

sofia: telemetry ask: emit a `reconciled_delta_pct` and `reconciled_latency_s` whenever reconciled differs from realtime by >5%. that'll let us quantify scope across tenants/models.

maya: add `reconciled_origin` tag too (ingest_order | kafka_repartition | producer_batching) so we can group by root cause later.

liam: infra action: I'll audit recent producer changes and revert batching if it's the culprit. also add sequence numbers on the producer side so we can detect reorders without relying solely on timestamps.

derek: sequence numbers + event_ts will let us compute monotonicity per partition. we can surface a small red badge on the Console card if we detect reorders > threshold.

nora: for billing exports we should always use reconciled view. add a migration note: "billing exports will switch to reconciled materialized view on 2024-06-01" and a backfill job for last 30 days.

sofia: can someone plumb the UI affordances? I'll wire the tooltip copy. Suggest copy: "Reconciled: computed after event-time processing; may change previous minutes' numbers."

maya: also add a progress indicator (spinning dot -> settled check) on the cost card while reconciliation is pending. simple and clear.

liam: I'll put together a short design doc for watermark configs and seq numbers. Derek, can you post the kafka producer audit here when done?

derek: will do — starting audit now. if we confirm producer-side batching as the main cause, plan is: revert batching tweak + roll forward seq-number + small consumer-side join-window to tolerate 60s.

nora: cost-bot: please mute realtime alerts for tenants with open ingest-reorder tickets and post a note on the dashboard when reconciliation changes cost >10%.

cost-bot: actioned: muted realtime alerts for affected tenants (ticket IN-4529). will emit reconciliation-change annotations when delta >10%.

sofia: final action list: 1) UI: dual-view card + tooltip + progress indicator (nora/sofia) 2) infra: seq-numbers + producer audit + possible revert (liam/derek) 3) streaming: event_time materialization + watermark config (liam) 4) telemetry: reconciled_delta_pct, reconciled_latency_s, reconciled_origin (sofia) 5) billing: migrate exports to reconciled + backfill (nora).

maya: thanks team. let's track in IN-4529 and circle back after infra audit. :thumbsup:
